summary: Resolve SIMPLEFIN_ACCESS_URL into a derived base URL + HTTP Basic auth header.
reason: SimpleFIN has no API key; the single credential is an Access URL (https://user:pass@host/simplefin) that encodes both the server host and Basic-auth creds. The stock AuthHeader would base64-encode the whole URL and BaseURL would stay at the bridge default.
validated_outcome: doctor derives base_url from the credential; live sync/accounts succeed against the bridge.
